method: Three ordinary aerial/court pictures actually inspected;standard retained PMTiles/global terrain;no bespoke archive/survey research.

references.observed: Whole aerial actually inspected:rectangular main quadrangle/open square court,three-four tall facade levels,rusticated base,gray-pink/tan wall fields,pale stone orders andgreen copper pitched/mansard roof ring. Lower west projecting wings connect to two detached curved guard ranges;east lower wings flank open garden. Neighbor church/roads/water independent.

West guard court actually inspected:two low curved ranges with real open column colonnades,closed back rooms,dark nearlyflat pitched roofs withgreen copper edges/vents andpale end balustrades. Their central west gap stays open. Principal west center has three arched entrance portals andclosed windows above;small sculptural reliefs may be original abstractions.

Inner court actually inspected:one large open paved void. Ground arches are predominantly closed glazing/doors,with central through portals;do not reuse Madrid-style open arcades all around. Upper rectangular windows,regular pale frames andpilasters,continuous cornice/roof edge. Interior rooms excluded.
